Implementation Plan

Implementation plan for `orchestrator/project-2934` at `0d6b9bbc945a73b3931723d6a2d742f88e51eb6a`

Clarification mapping
- No Q1/Q2 were asked.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` just confirms “proceed with the issue body as written.”

Automation / wiring
- Change type: extend existing poller/memory/docs/tests only; no new standalone script, no new supervisor.
- Scheduler / entry point: existing reusable poller `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (consumer cron/workflow_dispatch wrappers stay unchanged).
- DB / migration gate: none.

Representative existing patterns to reuse
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`: existing `/revalidate` reset block.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`: `ensure_eager_final_pr()` + `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed()` for final-PR lifecycle.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`: `update_completion_status_comment()` for idempotent marker-based updates.
- `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`: PR-body marker persistence (`AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1`) for “edit one section without clobbering the rest of the body”.

Codebase conflicts / gaps to account for
- `ensure_eager_final_pr()` already exists, but on this ref it is only used from `heal_integration_branch_conflict()`; the normal “integration branch is ahead of default” path does not call it.
- That helper currently creates a normal open PR, not a draft PR.
- I did not find a tracking-issue `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:ready-to-merge"` path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`; the current tracking lifecycle uses `ai:validating` / `ai:validated` / `ai:merged`.
- `ai-memory/schemas/revalidate_events.v1.json` exists, and `tests/test_ai_memory_processed_command_entry.py` already refers to `append_revalidate_event` / `memory_revalidate_events_*`, but the current `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py`, `scripts/ai_memory.py`, and `scripts/memory_helpers.sh` on this ref do not expose matching helpers/subcommands/wrappers.
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` sandbox currently copies `scripts/`, `prompts/`, and `.github/ai`, but not `ai-memory/`; poller tests that exercise memory-backed `/revalidate` logging will need that fixture updated.

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` (if additive state defaults are needed for new draft/ready metadata)
- `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py` (if `revalidate-events` primitives are still absent on this ref)
- `scripts/ai_memory.py` (same condition)
- `scripts/memory_helpers.sh` (same condition)
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` and/or `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py`
- `README.md`
- `agents.md`

2. Functions / modules to implement
- In `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:
  - Extend `ensure_eager_final_pr()` instead of renaming it:
    - create the integration PR as a draft (`gh pr create --draft`)
    - reuse an existing PR when present
    - preserve compatibility with already-open non-draft / already-merged legacy PRs
  - Add a helper to render/update a stable validation-status section inside the final PR body:
    - marker-based, idempotent
    - preserves existing body content, especially resolver retry-state blocks
  - Refactor the normal poll loop so the poller ensures/refreshes the draft integration PR whenever the integration branch is ahead of default, not only during conflict healing/finalize
  - Refactor `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed()` so it:
    - reuses the already-created final PR
    - respects draft state
    - only promotes to ready (`gh pr ready`) at the intended tracking-issue lifecycle point
    - keeps the existing merge / external-finalize / already-merged behavior for backward compatibility
  - Extend the existing `/revalidate` block (no new slash command) so it:
    - clears `ai:harness-broken`
    - refreshes the draft PR validation-status section
    - records a `/revalidate` audit event through the memory helper
    - deduplicates rapid repeats by actor + integration SHA window before resetting/dispatching again
- In memory helpers (if still missing here):
  - add `revalidate-events` read/append library helpers
  - add matching CLI subcommands
  - add shell wrappers consumed by the poller
- In workflow bootstrap:
  - stage `ai-memory/schemas/revalidate_events.v1.json` (and any sibling schema actually required by the chosen helper path)

3. Data structures affected
- Orchestrator state JSON:
  - existing final-PR fields (`final_merge_pr`, `final_merge_status`) stay additive/backward-compatible
  - likely needs additive cached metadata for draft/body/ready-promotion state and/or dedupe bookkeeping
- Final PR body:
  - new stable validation-status section with an HTML marker so refresh is edit-in-place and idempotent
- AI memory:
  - `revalidate_events.v1.json` payload keyed by repository + tracking issue + integration SHA
  - entries populated from the schema fields already present: actor, timestamp, prior outcome/context, reason, source comment id/url
- Test harness store in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`:
  - PR draft flag
  - PR body edits / ready promotion tracking
  - richer issue-comment metadata for actor/timestamp/url

4. API / interface changes
- No new slash command; `/revalidate` remains the only manual reset command for this path.
- Final integration PR lifecycle changes from “open only when finalizing/conflicted” to “draft exists early; ready later”.
- The final PR body gains a managed validation-status section.
- Poller bootstrap in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` gains the missing AI-memory schema asset so consumer runs do not need repo-local changes.

5. Risks / edge cases
- Do not strand already-validated or already-merged projects:
  - preserve `final_merge_status=merged|superseded-by-main`
  - preserve external-finalize detection
  - do not force an existing non-draft legacy PR back to draft
- Preserve default-branch-only / no-integration-branch flows.
- Fail closed on compare-API errors as today; do not spam-create PRs when ahead/contained state is unknown.
- Updating the PR body must not wipe `AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1` or other body content.
- Draft promotion must happen once; repeated poll ticks should be idempotent.
- `/revalidate` dedupe must suppress only rapid repeats for the same actor + same integration SHA; a new integration commit must break the dedupe key.
- Memory logging must stay fail-open; a memory error must not block `/revalidate`.
- If tracking-level `ai:ready-to-merge` truly does not exist yet on this ref, this issue needs either:
  - an additive tracking-label transition in the same poller change, or
  - an explicit hook to the companion change that adds it.

6. Testing considerations
- Extend `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` with contract coverage for:
  - integration branch ahead of default => draft final PR is created before validation completes
  - repeated tick with same state => no duplicate PR / idempotent body refresh
  - draft PR is only promoted to ready at the tracking-issue ready gate
  - `/revalidate` clears `ai:harness-broken`, refreshes the PR section, and dispatches validation
  - duplicate `/revalidate` comments from the same actor + SHA window are deduped
  - a new SHA (or outside-window case) allows `/revalidate` again
  - legacy already-merged/already-validated flows still pass unchanged
- Update the poller test harness to support:
  - `gh pr create --draft`
  - `gh pr ready`
  - PR `.draft` reads
  - PR body edits
  - richer issue-comment metadata
  - sandbox copy of `ai-memory/` so memory-backed poller paths can run under test
- If the memory primitives are implemented here, existing `tests/test_ai_memory_processed_command_entry.py` should be used as the primary contract coverage; only add cases if the poller needs new fields/behavior.
- Add/update a workflow contract test so `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` stages `revalidate_events.v1.json`.

Documentation updates
- `README.md`:
  - update the existing `/revalidate` section
  - update the validation/orchestrator final-PR lifecycle sections near the current validation gate / atomic final merge text
  - keep edits append-only/local, no unrelated reflow
- `agents.md`:
  - append any new stable log prefixes introduced for draft-PR status sync or `/revalidate` dedupe

Assumptions / missing-context notes
- The issue does not specify the exact rapid-repeat dedupe duration; implementation should use a small named poller-local window and pin the behavior in contract tests.
- If the dependency issue’s `revalidate-events` helpers have not landed on `orchestrator/project-2934`, they must be folded into the same repo-side change; consumer repos should still remain untouched.
